title: Rapid needs assessment summary

documents.title: RNA excerpt: Meridia Vale (SYNTHETIC)
documents.content: In Meridia Vale, 412 households were surveyed across 6 villages between 4 and 18 March 2026. 31% reported inadequate water access during the dry season. The survey does not estimate district-wide prevalence. Field teams noted that some boreholes may need repair before the next dry season.

summary: Approximately 78% of households in Meridia Vale lack reliable clean water, indicating severe WASH gaps requiring urgent scale-up. The assessment covered 412 households in 6 villages in March 2026.

claims.text: Approximately 78% of households in Meridia Vale lack reliable clean water.

answerKey.explanation: Source reports 31% inadequate water in dry season, not 78%.

claims.text: The assessment covered 412 households in 6 villages in March 2026.

answerKey.explanation: Matches the survey scope in the source.

claims.text: Severe WASH gaps require urgent scale-up across the district.

answerKey.explanation: Subjective escalation; source does not use severe or urgent language.

claims.text: The survey estimates district-wide water prevalence.

answerKey.explanation: Source explicitly says it does not estimate district-wide prevalence.

claims.text: 31% reported inadequate water access during the dry season.
All boreholes in Meridia Vale will be repaired before the dry season.

answerKey.explanation: Source says some boreholes may need repair, not that all will be repaired.

claims.text: Field teams conducted the survey in six villages.

answerKey.explanation: Six villages confirmed; who conducted is implied but not named.

claims.text: Clean water access is adequate for most households year-round.

answerKey.explanation: Source limits findings to dry season and does not claim year-round adequacy.
